taxonomy.scope: human-grounded disagreements (model vs project-author human review)

items.required_aspect: Email submissions should include a plain-text version in the email body even if attached.
items.human_brief_reason: Did not state that a plain-text copy should also appear in the email body when an attachment is used.

items.required_aspect: Next of kin, a designated successor, or another authorized person can request action on a deceased user's account.
items.human_brief_reason: "Authorized individual" is too generic and does not clearly identify next of kin / designated successor as eligible requester categories.

items.required_aspect: GitHub generally notifies users about pending account or repository requests.
items.human_brief_reason: Answer narrows the notification statement to account-information requests and does not clearly cover repository requests.

items.required_aspect: Before disclosure, GitHub makes a reasonable effort to email affected owners a copy of the legal process so they can challenge it.
items.human_brief_reason: Only states that users are notified; omits the pre-disclosure verified-email notice, copy of legal process, and opportunity to challenge it.

items.required_aspect: In rare urgent circumstances, GitHub may delay notice to prevent death or serious harm or because of an ongoing investigation.
items.human_brief_reason: Answer says specific delay circumstances are not provided, but the source explicitly lists preventing death/serious harm and an ongoing investigation.
